question.text: The method of zone refining of metals is based on the principle of

options.text: greater mobility of the pure metal than that of impurity.
greater solubility of the impurity in the molten state than in the solid.
higher melting point of the impurity than that of the pure metal.

solution.text: A movable heater is fitted around a rod of impure metal. As heater is moved from one end to another pure metal crystallises while impurities pass on to adjacent melted zone.
